name: Beneath the Incandescent Stars: A Femboy Erotic-Romance VN Collection
source:
Beneath the Incandescent Stars is a collection of femboy VNs, featuring erotic-romance short stories where the player chooses the spice level of key scenes.
Story One: Beneath the Incandescent Stars
Play along whilst Sam recounts the night he met Jessy—a free-hearted femboy with a penchant for roller skating—and of their chance encounter that propels them toward the inexplicable force of love.
Story Two: Bright, Bold Glamour
While on a working trip in a bustling city, Charlie, a prim and proper femboy, encounters the beautiful Cherry Aplomb, a bold and outgoing porn star. It isn’t long before Charlie develops a crush on Cherry and dares to ask her out on a date.
Story Three: Waning Flames
Lena and Isabelle are two femboys whose relationship has reached breaking point. In a last-ditch effort to save this waning relationship, they have agreed to meet up for a date that will either restore their love or forever cement their separation.
